title: InstallLens
summary: Offline npm lockfile preflight for install-script approvals and unusual dependency sources.
problem: JavaScript developers need a quick way to review npm install-time execution and unusual dependency sources before running installation commands.
audience: Developers reviewing an npm project or dependency update before install.
why_now: npm v12 made dependency install scripts, Git dependencies, and remote URL dependencies opt-in by default, increasing the need to review lockfile policy surfaces deliberately.
difference: InstallLens reads existing package-lock.json and optional package.json offline before install; it does not require registry access or package upload.
monetization_hypothesis: Likely better as a free local utility; a paid team policy/dashboard layer would need separate validation.
limitations: Does not determine whether package code is malicious.
Lockfiles do not expose every runtime behavior.

alternatives.name: npm install-scripts / approve-scripts
alternatives.difference: npm manages execution policy during installation; InstallLens gives a read-only offline lockfile summary before install.

alternatives.name: Socket
alternatives.difference: Socket provides broader package threat intelligence; InstallLens is a zero-account local preflight focused on lockfile install-policy surface.
